m: प्रति-˚सांधानिक m. (fr. ˚संधान) a bard, panegyrist, L.
a: प्रतिसांधानिकः — A bard, panegyrist.

v: vIpsAyAm avyayI॰ ac samA॰ । pratye kasAmani
m: प्रति—साम mfn. (prob.) unkind, unfriendly, Pāṇ. v, 4, 75.
प्रति—सामन्त m. ‘a hostile neighbour’, enemy, adversary, Kuval.; Hcar.
प्रति—सामर्थ्य n. relative suitableness, R.

m: प्रति-˚सारणीय mfn. to be dressed or anointed (as a wound), Car.
to be applied for dressing a wound, Suśr.

m: प्रति-˚सारण n. (fr. Caus.) dressing and anointing the edges of a wound (or an instrument for doing so), Suśr.
N. of a partic. process to which minerals (esp. quicksilver) are subjected, Cat.
a: प्रतिसारणं — 1 Dressing the edges of a wound. --2 An instrument used for anointing a wound.

v: tri॰ pratIpaM sarati sf--Ric--Rini । 1 pratIpagAmini 2 nIcagAmini striyAM NIp । BA॰ va॰ 51 a॰ ।
m: प्रति-˚सारिन् mfn. going round or from one to the other, MBh.
प्रति-˚सारित mfn. (fr. Caus.) repelled, removed, Vikr.
dressed (as a wound), Suśr.
प्रति—सायम् ind. towards evening, Gobh.

s: pratisIrA
strI, (pratisinoti pratibaDnAtIti । prati + si + “SusicimiYAM dIrGaSca .” uRA॰ 2 । 25 । iti kran dIrGaSca । tatazwAp .) yavanikA । vyavaDAyakapawaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 120 ॥
v: strI pratisinoti sIyate vA prati + si--rak dIrGaSca । javanikAyAm (paradA) amarakozaH ।
m: प्रति—सीरा f. a curtain, L.
a screen or wall of cloth, an outer tent, W.
a: प्रतिसीरा — A screen, curtain, wall of cloth.

k.v: अस्त्री वितानमुल्लोचो दूष्याद्यं वस्त्रवेश्मनि। प्रतिसीरा जवनिका स्यात्तिरस्करिणी च सा॥

m: प्रति-स्खलित mfn. (√ स्खल्) warded off, Śiś. (= प्रति-ष्कुत, Nir. vi, 16).
प्रति-√ स्फुर् P. -स्फुरति, to push away, remove, RV.
प्रति—स्थानम् ind. in every place, everywhere, Prab., Sch.
प्रति—सूर्य—शयानक m. ‘lying or basking in the sun’, a kind of lizard, a chameleon, L.
प्रति—सूर्य (or ˚यक) m. a mock sun, parhelion, Var.; a kind of lizard, a chameleon (which lies or basks in the sun), Uttarar.; Suśr.
प्रति—सूर्यम् ind. opposite to the sun, Mn.
प्रति—सूर्य—मत्स्य m. a partic. appearance in the sun
(accord. to Comm.) a mock sun and a comet, Āp.

puM, (pratisUryya + svArTe kan .) kfkalAsaH । (yaTA, uttararAmacarite dvitIye'Nke । “sImAnaH pradarodarezu vilasatsvalpAmBaso yA svayaM tfzyadBiH pratisUryyakErajagarasvedadravaH pIyate ॥” taddazwasya cikitsA suSrute kalpasTAne 8 aDyAye uktA । yaTA, -- “pratisUryyakadazwAnAM sarpadazwavadAcaret ॥”) upasUryyakamaRqalam । iti viSvaH ॥ (asya SuBASuBalakzaRam । yaTA, bfhatsaMhitAyAm । 37 । 1-3 । “pratisUryyakaH praSasto divasakfdftuvarRasapraBaH snigDaH । vEdUryyaniBaH svacCaH SuklaSca kzemasOBikzaH ॥ pIto vyADiM janayatyaSokarUpaSca SastrakopAya । pratisUryyARAM mAlA dasyuBayAtaNkanfpahantrI ॥ divasakftaH pratisUryyo jalakfdudagdakziRe sTito'nilakft । uBayasTaH salilaBayaM nfpamupari nihantyaDo janahA ॥”)

m: प्रति-सं-√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, (P.) to put together again, re-arrange, ŚBr.; (Ā.) to put on, adjust (an arrow), MBh.; (Ā.) to return, reply, Hariv.; BhP.; (P. Ā.) to remember, recollect, Nyāyas.; (Ā.) to comprehend, understand, Prab. vi, 2/3.
a: प्रतिसंधा — {c3c} U. 1 To re-adjust. --2 To aim at, direct --3 To conceive, comprehend. --4 To be, fasten. --5 To put on, wear. --6 To restore, return. --7 To compose oneself. --8 To fit (as an arrow to the bow-string.)

m: प्रति-˚संधान n. putting together again, joining together, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a juncture, the period of transition between two ages, VāyuP.
memory, recollection, Nyāyas., Sch.
praise, panegyric, L.
self-command, suppression of feeling for a time, W.
a remedy, MW.
a: प्रतिसंधानं — 1 Joining together, uniting. --2 The period of transition between two ages. --3 A means, remedy. --4 Self-command, restraint of feelings or passions. --5 Praise.

m: प्रति-˚संधातृ m. one who recollects or remembers, Nyāyas.
प्रति-˚संधेय mfn. to be opposed (अप्र्˚, ‘irresistible’), MBh.
प्रति-˚संधि m. reunion, MBh.
re-entry into (comp.) or into the womb, L.
re-birth, Divyāv.
the period of transition between two ages, VāyuP.
resistance, adverseness (of fate), MBh.
a: प्रतिसंधिः — 1 Reunion. --2 Entering into the womb. --3 The period of transition between two ages. --4 Stop, cessation (उपरम).

m: प्रति-˚संधि—ज्ञान n. recognition, Nyāyas., Sch.
प्रति-˚संधित mfn. (cf. संधय) fastened, strengthened, confirmed, BhP.

v: strI prati + sam + KyA--BAve aN । 1 prasaKyAne 2 sAMKyAdisidDe jYAnaBede ca tasya paYcaviMSatisaMKyAnvitatattvanirUpaRAt tadIyajYAnasya saMKyAniyatatvena taTAtvam ।
m: प्रति-सं-√ ख्या (only ind.p. ख्याय), to count or reckon up, number, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
प्रति-˚संख्या f. consciousness
a: प्रतिसंख्या — Consciousness.

m: प्रति-˚संख्यान n. the tranquil consideration of a matter, Jātakam.

v: pu॰ pratisaNKyApUrvakoniroDaH SA॰ ta॰ । budDipUrvake BAvAnAM nASe bOdDamatasidDe padArTaBede apratisaMKyAniroDaSabde 561 pf॰ dfSyam ।
m: प्रति-˚संख्या—निरोध m. (with, Buddh.) the conscious annihilation of an object (?), Dharmas. 32 (cf. अ-प्र्˚-न्˚).
प्रति-सं-√ श्रि P. -श्रयति, to seek refuge or protection in reply, MBh.
प्रति-सं-√ श्रु (only ind.p. -श्रुत्य), to promise, MBh.
प्रति-सं-√ चर् P. -चरति, to meet, come together, MBh.
प्रति-˚संचर m. going or moving backwards (अ-प्र्˚), Suśr.
re-absorption or resolution (back again into Prakṛti), Śaṃk.; MārkP.
that into which anything is re-absorbed or resolved, MBh.
a place of resort, haunt, ib.
a: प्रतिसंचरः — 1 Moving backwards. --2 Reabsorption. --3 Especially, reabsorption (of the world) back into Prakṛti. --4 A place of resort, haunt.

m: प्रति-˚संदेश m. a message in return, answer to a m˚, R.; Mṛcch.; Kathās.
a: प्रतिसंदेशः — A message in return, an answer to a message.

m: प्रति-˚संदेष्टव्य mfn. (an answer) to be given in reply to a m˚, Kād.
प्रति-सं-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to give a person (acc. or haste with gen.) a message or commission in return, R.; Kād.; to send back a message to (gen.), MBh.; to order, command, ib.

a: प्रतिसंगक्षिका — A cloak to keep off dust.
प्रतिसंगिन् — a. Clinging or adhering to, attached to.

m: प्रति-सं-√ ग्रह् P. Ā. -गृह्णाति, ˚णीते, to receive, accept, MBh.; R.; to meet with, find, MBh.
प्रति-˚संहार m. drawing in, withdrawing, MBh.
giving up, resigning, ib.
keeping away, abstention from (abl.), ib.
compression, diminution, W.
comprehension, ib.
a: प्रतिसंहारः — 1 Taking back, withdrawing. --2 Diminution, compression. --3 Comprehension, inclusion. --4 Yielding, giving up.

m: प्रति-˚संहरणीय n. (sc. कर्मन्) a partic. punishment, L.

प्रति-सं-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to draw together, contract (with आत्मानम्, ‘one's self’ i.e. to shrink, return to its usual bed, said of the sea), Hariv.; to draw or keep back, withdraw (as a weapon, the eye &c.), MBh.; Kāv.; to take away, put off, Āpast.; to absorb, annihilate, destroy, MBh.; Pur.; Jātakam.; to check, stop, repress, MBh.; R. &c.; to change, MW. : Caus. -हारयति, to retract, R.
a: प्रतिसंहृ — {c1c} P. 1 To draw back, withdraw, draw in; तत्साधुकृतसंधानं प्रतिसंहर सायकं Ś. 1. 11; R. 3. 64. --2 To retract, take back. --3 To compress, reduce in bulk. --4 To change.

m: प्रति-˚संहृत mfn. kept back, checked, restrained, R.
comprehended, included, W.
compressed, reduced in bulk, ib.
a: प्रतिसंहृत — p. p. 1 Taken back, withdrawn; एष प्रतिसंहृतः Ś. 1. --2 Comprehended, included. --3 Compressed.

m: प्रति-सं-√ हृष् P. -हर्षति, to rejoice again, be glad, MBh.
प्रति-˚संहृष्ट mfn. glad, merry, R.
प्रति-संहित See col. 2.
प्रति-˚संहित mfn. aimed at, directed against, MBh.
प्रति-सं-जात mfn. (√ जन्) born, sprung up, arisen, R.
प्रति-सं-√ ज्ञा Ā. -जानीते, to be kindly disposed, ŚBr.
प्रति-˚संजिहीर्षु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to withdraw or to be freed from (abl.), BhP.
प्रति-सं-काश m. (√ काश्) a similar appearance, resemblance, MBh.
प्रति-सं-√ क्रम् Ā. -क्रमते, to go back again, come to an end, BhP. : Caus. -क्रामयति, to cause to go back or return, ib.
प्रति-˚संक्रमा f. impression, Sarvad.
प्रति-˚संक्रम m. re-absorption, dissolution (m.c. also ˚क्राम), ib.
a: प्रतिसंक्रमः — 1 Reabsorption. --2 Reflection (प्रतिच्छाया).

m: प्रति-सं-क्रुद्ध mfn. (√ क्रुध्) angry with, wroth against (acc.), MBh.; R.
प्रति-संकुचित mfn. closed, Bcar.
प्रति-˚संलीन mfn. retired, in privacy, Divyāv.
complete retirement for the sake of meditation, Lalit.
प्रति-सं-लयन n. (√ ली) retirement into a lonely place, privacy, Lalit.; Divyāv.
complete absorption, SaddhP.
प्रति-सं-√ रभ् Ā. -रभते, to seize, take hold of MBh. vii, 3169 (B. -सं-चरते).
प्रति-˚संरब्ध mfn. (pl.) holding one another by the hands, MBh.
excited, furious, ib.; R.
प्रति-सं-रुद्ध mfn. (√ रुध्) contracted into itself shrunk, BhP.
प्रति-सं-स्थान n. (√ स्था) settling in, entering into (comp.), Lalit.
a: प्रतिसंस्थानं — Setting in, entering into.

m: प्रति-˚संसर्ग m. = प्रतिसर्ग, VāyuP.
प्रति-सं-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to mingle with (instr.), Suśr.
प्रति-˚संसृष्ट mfn. mingled with (instr.), ib.
प्रति-˚संसृष्ट—भक्त mfn. one who is temperate in eating, ib.
प्रति-˚संस्कार m. restoration (˚रं-√ कृ, to restore), Kāraṇḍ.
प्रति-˚संस्कारणा f. id., L.
प्रति—संस्कारम् ind. at every ceremony, ĀpŚr.
प्रति-सं-स्कृ (√ स्कृ = कृ; only Pot. -कुर्यात्), to repair, restore, Mn. ix, 279.
प्रति-˚संस्कृत mfn. joined or united with (comp.), Suśr.
प्रति-सं-√ स्मृ P. -स्मरति, to remember, R.
प्रति-सं-√ स्तम्भ् (only ind.p. -स्तभ्य), to strengthen, encourage, MārkP.
प्रति-सं-स्तर n. (√ स्तृ) friendly reception, L.
प्रति-संवादिन् (?), m. an adversary (prob. for प्रति-वादिन्), Hir. i, 15, 6.
प्रति-सं-√ वद् Ā. -वदते, to agree with any one (acc.), AitBr.
प्रति—संवत्सरम् ind. at every year, yearly, Yājñ.; ĀpŚr. Comm.
प्रति-˚संवेदक mfn. giving detailed information, L.
a: प्रतिसंवेदक — a. Giving detailed information about.

m: प्रति-˚संवेदन n. experiment, enjoyment, Nyāyas., Sch.
प्रति-˚संवेदिन् mfn. feeling, experiencing, being conscious of anything, ib.
प्रति-सं-√ वेष्ट् Ā. -वेष्टते, to shrivel, shrink up, contract, MBh.
प्रति-सं-वि-धान n. (√ 1. धा) a counter action, stroke in return, Mcar.
प्रति-सं-√ विद् Caus. -वेदयति, to recognize (?), Divyāv. (Ā. p. -वेदयमान, feeling, ib.)
प्रति-˚संविद् f. analytical science (4 with Buddhists), Dharmas. 51; Lalit.
a: प्रतिसंविद् — f. An accurate knowledge of the particulars of anything.

m: प्रति-˚सं˚विन्-निश्चयावतारा f. N. of a partic. Dhāraṇī, L.
प्रति-˚सं˚वित्-प्राप्त m. N. of a Bodhisattva, ib.
प्रति-सं-यात mfn. (√ या) going against, assailing (with acc.), MBh.
प्रति-सं-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to fight against, ŚBr.
प्रति-˚संयत्त mfn. completely prepared or armed, MBh.
प्रति—संयोद्धृ m. an adversary in war, MBh.
प्रति-˚संयोद्धृ m. an adversary in war, MBh.
प्रति-सं-√ युध् (only pf. -युयुधुः), to resist an attack together, BhP.
प्रति-सं-युक्त mfn. (√ युज्) bound or attached to something else, MBh. (B.)
प्रति—सङ्गक्षिका f. a cloak to keep off the dust (worn by Buddhist mendicants), L. (prob. w.r. for -संकक्षिका).
प्रति-सङ्गिन् mfn. (√ सञ्ज्) cleaving or clinging to, adhering
(अ-प्र्˚) not meeting with any obstacle, irresistible, Hariv.

v: pu॰ pratirUpaH saMkramaH prA॰ sa॰ । 1 praticCAyAyAm prA॰ va॰ । 2 pratisaMkrAnte praticCAyApanne tri॰ । 3 saYcAre ca “citiSaktirapariRAminyapratisaMkramA darSitavizayA SudDA'nantA ceti” pAta॰ BA॰ । “pravisaMkramaH saMYcAraH” vivaraRam ।

pu॰ pratisaYcaranti kriyASUnyatayA vilIyante'syAM prati + sam + cara--ADAre ap । 1 pralayaBede “yadA tu vrakftO yAti layaM viSvamidaM jagat । tadocyate prAkfto'yaM vidvadBiH pratisaYcaraH” mArka॰ pu॰ । 6 a॰ । 2 saYcAramAtre ca ।

m: प्रति-√ सच् Ā. -सचते, to pursue with vengeance, ŚBr.
प्रति-√ सद् P. -सीदति (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 66), to start back, abhor, MBh.
प्रति—सदनम् ind. every one to his dwelling, Mcar.
प्रति—सदृक्ष or प्रति—सदृश् (प्रति-), mfn. similar, VS.
प्रति—सद्म ind. at or in every house, BhP.
प्रति-√ सह् Ā. -सहते, to be a match for, overcome (acc.), R.
प्रति-सम्-आ-√ धा P. -दधाति, to put back again, replace, re-arrange, restore, Daś.; to redress, correct (an error), Śaṃk.
प्रति-˚समाधान n. collecting one's self again, composure, Kād.
cure, remedy, W.
a: प्रतिसमाधानं — Cure, remedy.

m: प्रति-सम्-आ-श्रित mfn. (√ श्रि) depending on (acc.), MBh.
प्रति-सम्-आ-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to answer, reply, Daś.; to order, command, R.
प्रति-˚समादिष्ट mfn. bidden, directed, ordered, commanded, R.; MārkP.
प्रति-˚समाहित mfn. fitted to the bowstring (as an arrow), MBh.
प्रति-सम्-आपन n. (√ आप्) the going against, attacking (with gen.), R.
प्रति-सम्-√ आस् Ā. -आस्ते, to be a match for, cope with, resist (acc.), MBh.; R.

v: na॰ prati + sam + cA + asa--kzepe BAve lyuw । nirasane nivAraRe BA॰ va॰ 1931 Slo॰ ।
m: प्रति-˚समासन n. the being a match for, with standing, resisting (with gen.), MBh.
a: प्रतिसमासनं — 1 Coping with, being a match for. --2 Resisting, opposing, withstanding.

m: प्रति-˚समासित mfn. equalled, opposed, fought, ib.
प्रति-सम्-√ भू P. -भवति, to apply or give one's self to (acc.), MBh.
प्रति-सम्-√ ईक्ष् Ā. -ईक्षते, to hold out, persevere (Sch. = √ जीव्), BhP.
प्रति-˚समीक्षण n. looking at again, returning a glance, ib.
